import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const output = readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
const count = (name) => {
  const match = output.match(new RegExp(`^# ${name} (\\d+)$`, 'm'));
  assert.ok(match, `Missing TAP summary: ${name}`);
  return Number(match[1]);
};
// All six ledger cases must execute; aggregate counts cannot hide a removed suite.
for (const name of [
  'campaign identity/cap/expiry are immutable and malformed money cannot authorize',
  'foreign databases are refused without replacing their records',
  'timeouts, retry IDs and restart retain reservations; duplicate IDs never redispatch',
  'only final receipt releases unused reservation; conflicting settlement and overruns are visible',
  'expired campaign cannot reserve even with remaining balance but final reconciliation remains possible',
  'independent processes cannot reserve the same funds twice; committed reservation survives exit without close',
]) {
  assert.ok(output.split(/\r?\n/).some(line => /^ok \d+ - /.test(line) && line.endsWith(` - ${name}`)),
    `Missing mandatory executed ledger test: ${name}`);
}
assert.ok(count('tests') > 0, 'Runtime tests must actually execute');
for (const name of [
  'unconfigured or denied trusted verifier cannot dispatch; client permission fields are forbidden',
  'success retains full reservation; duplicate request and reopen never redispatch',
  'timeout aborts one attempt and preserves uncertain full hold without retry',
  'provider/model mismatch, tools, fallback and prompt mutation are rejected before dispatch',
  'missing/expired pricing or unknown other costs cannot reserve or dispatch',
  'independent ledger connections racing distinct steps cannot overspend campaign cap',
  'provider response violation retains hold and a policy revision cannot reset prior spend',
  'actual scope, output bound, expiry and pre-aborted calls fail before dispatch',
  'retained verifier references and mutable originals cannot change the approved dispatch snapshot',
]) {
  assert.ok(output.split(/\r?\n/).some(line => /^ok \d+ - /.test(line) && line.endsWith(` - ${name}`)),
    `Missing mandatory executed held dispatch test: ${name}`);
}
for (const name of [
  'timeouts are finite integer bounded and reject malformed configuration',
  'deadline aborts the actual in-flight fake provider once',
  'already cancelled caller cannot invoke provider; caller cancellation propagates',
  'fast success clears timer and provider errors are never retried',
  'a noncooperative provider remains bounded locally without claiming remote cancellation',
  'openai real SDK receives per-request maxRetries zero and performs one fake fetch on 503',
  'openai actual SDK fake fetch sees timeout abort',
  'anthropic real SDK receives per-request maxRetries zero and performs one fake fetch on 503',
  'anthropic actual SDK fake fetch sees timeout abort',
  'Gemini adapter forwards cancellation and rejects already-aborted work before client acquisition',
  'Gemini installed SDK propagates signal into its actual fetch transport',
  'router aborts its actual provider invocation on timeout without retry',
  'invalid router timeout fails before provider resolution',
]) {
  assert.ok(output.split(/\r?\n/).some(line => /^\s*ok \d+ - /.test(line) && line.endsWith(` - ${name}`)),
    `Missing mandatory executed cancellation test: ${name}`);
}
assert.equal(count('pass'), count('tests'), 'Every runtime test must pass');
for (const kind of ['fail', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'todo']) {
  assert.equal(count(kind), 0, `${kind} tests are not permitted`);
}
NODE
